## What's free

Cloud free tier discontinued in June 2025; 14-day trial, then pay-as-you-go

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://openobserve.ai/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

Excluded: no free cloud tier. The self-hosted Enterprise edition is free up to 50 GB/day and can run on a freelunch host.
